text.Barter World:
How to Play ==
At any time during your turn, gain either 2 Trade or 2 Authority (but not both). Also, at any time during your turn you may scrap Barter World to gain 5 Combat.
 Strategy ==
Offering 2 Trade or 2 Authority gives you some flexibility in the early game to buy the more expensive cards. Trade is probably favored over Authority. Attackers can bypass the Barter World, but most of the time won't. Adding 5 damage damage as a scrap ability is a decent boost to your attack.
